prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: architectural editorial photograph for a premium fictional Berlin joinery studio website hero
Primary request: an exceptionally beautiful understated bespoke oak kitchen in a quiet Berlin apartment, photographed with the precision and natural texture of an independent interiors magazine.
Scene/backdrop: softly worn ivory lime-plaster walls, high ceilings, a tall side window, pale warm stone floor, no people.
Subject: long built-in kitchen in natural European oak with beautifully joined flat-front cabinets, subtly recessed handles, a creamy honed limestone worktop, a single understated dark bronze faucet, one simple ceramic bowl and a few bare branches. Oak cabinet grain and real joints must be visible, spare lived-in restraint.
Composition/framing: wide horizontal architectural photograph, eye-level perspective, rectilinear lens and straight verticals, island or low worktop in the foreground, cabinetry along the back wall, gentle asymmetric composition, all image area contains the room. No typography or graphics; this image will be used under webpage copy outside the photo.
Lighting/mood: late afternoon natural sunlight from the left, long soft shadows, warm but desaturated, tactile, peaceful, refined.
Color palette: muted honey oak, chalk ivory, stone, graphite accents.
Materials/textures: realistic oak end grain, tiny imperfections, matte plaster, honed stone; convincingly photographic rather than a CGI render.
Constraints: no text, no logos, no watermark, no fake signage, no people, no excessive decor, no glossy surfaces.

Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: supporting architectural craft editorial photograph for a fictional Berlin bespoke joinery studio
Primary request: intimate, exceptionally tactile editorial photograph of an unfinished solid European oak cabinet drawer resting diagonally on a worn joiner's workbench in a quiet contemporary woodworking studio. Clearly legible beautiful hand-cut dovetail joinery and timber end grain are the central focus.
Scene/backdrop: modest workshop with softly blurred timber boards and an ivory wall; a single wooden hand plane and a few fresh curled wood shavings on the workbench, restrained believable tools, no people.
Subject: the corner joint of a substantial oak drawer, finely fitted dovetail pins, gently rounded edges, natural wood grain. The open drawer and a partially finished low oak cabinet behind it suggest furniture being made.
Style/medium: premium magazine documentary photograph, photorealistic, no CGI polish.
Composition/framing: vertical portrait composition, tightly framed on the oak drawer corner at lower center, joinery crisp and detailed, plane and shavings nearby, shallow but sufficient depth of field, authentic 50mm lens look.
Lighting/mood: soft natural side-window daylight, quiet muted warmth, tactile shadows, calm attention to handwork.
Color palette: honey oak, warm ivory, dusty taupe, charcoal accents.
Constraints: no writing, no logos, no watermark, no signage, no people, no exaggerated sawdust, no decorative clutter. Realistic woodworking geometry and tool proportions.
